lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with the central row exhibiting the highest pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid pattern where the blobs serve as the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by high-luminance leading edges and shadowed trailing edges.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density micro-speckling of high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin and the anterior cranial region.
